newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-BALLESTEROS BACK ON FORM WITH A 66.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BALLESTEROS BACK ON FORM WITH A 66.

text.p: European Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros returned to something like his best form with a six under par 66 at the Oki Pro-Am European Tour event on Friday.
His two-round aggregate of 138 put him in a joint-lead with fellow Spaniard Pedro Linhart, Briton Stuart Cage and Sweden's Joakim Haeggman.

Ballesteros, who has been struggling for months to regain top form, said: "This is one of the best rounds I have played this year. It could have been better because I three-putted the 10th from nowhere, missed a few birdie chances and I did not drive too well."

U.S. Ryder Cup captain Tom Kite, who shot a 68 for 139 to be just one behind, said: "I'd love Seve to keep playing well and finish second this week. But I'm also sure he would love me to finish second."

Linhart, who was overnight leader on 65, was two shots clear of the field with only two holes to play but then three-putted the 17th and drove into a bunker at the last to bogey both holes and fall back to six under.
